items: Zero order: rate reactants ki concentration se azad hai; concentration ki tabdeeli ka raftar par koi asar nahi. A se product ke liye rate = k [A]^0 = k. Misalein: H2 + Cl2 se 2HCl, rate = k [H2]^0 [Cl2]^0 = k; 2NH3 se N2 + 3H2, rate = k [NH3]^0 = k. Photochemical reactions aam taur par zero order hain.

Pehla order: kai reactants ho sakte hain, magar sirf ek ki concentration rate badalti hai. Dinitrogen pentoxide ka tootna, 2N2O5(g) se 2N2O4(g) + O2(g), tajurbati rate muadla rate = k [N2O5] rakhta hai, N2O5 ke lihaz se pehla order.

Doosra order: rate muadle ke exponents ka majmooa 2 hai, ya ek reactant doosri taqat par, rate = k [A]^2, ya do reactants har ek pehli taqat par, rate = k [A][B]. Ozone se nitric oxide ka oxidation, NO + O3 se NO2 + O2, NO mein pehla order aur O3 mein pehla order hai, rate = k [NO][O3], kul doosra order.

Teesra order: exponents ka majmooa 3 hai, jaise rate = k [A]^3, k [A]^2 [B] ya k [A][B][C]. Reaction 2FeCl3 + 6KI se 2FeI2 + 6KCl + I2 mein aath reactant molecules hain magar yeh teesre order ki payi gai hai, rate = k [FeCl3][KI]^2; aur 2NO + O2 se 2NO2 teesre order ki hai, rate = k [NO]^2 [O2].

Fractional order: exponents ka majmooa kasar (fraction) hai. Chloroform se carbon tetrachloride ka banna, CHCl3(l) + Cl2(g) se CCl4(l) + HCl(g), rate = k [CHCl3][Cl2]^1/2 rakhta hai, order 1 + 1/2 = 1.5. Free radicals wali reactions aksar fractional orders dikhati hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek reaction kisi reactant mein doosre order ki hai. Woh concentration dugni karne par, aur aadhi karne par, rate kaise badalti hai? rate = k [NO]^2 [NH3]^0 aur rate = k [BrO3-][Br-][H+]^2 ke kul orders kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Concentration dugni karne se rate 2^2 = 4 se zarb hoti hai; aadhi karne se rate 4 se taqseem. Pehla rate law kul doosre order ka hai (2 + 0); doosra kul chauthe order ka (1 + 1 + 2).

items: Zero order: rate = k, concentration se azad (photochemical H2 + Cl2). Pehla: rate = k [N2O5]. Doosra: rate = k [A]^2 ya k [A][B] (NO + O3). Teesra: k [NO]^2 [O2], k [FeCl3][KI]^2. Fractional: k [CHCl3][Cl2]^1/2, order 1.5 (free radicals).
